subject: Cannot open June payslip
body: The June payslip link in Keka shows an error for me. Can you check?

replies.body: Fixed — your payslip was regenerated after the bank-account update. It opens correctly now; sorry for the trouble.

subject: Earned leave balance looks wrong
body: My earned leave shows 9 remaining but I calculated 10 — can someone verify?

replies.body: Verified against the ledger — one earned-leave day from 17 Jun was recorded late, which explains the difference. The balance of 9 is correct; the ledger view now shows that entry.

subject: PF transfer from previous employer stuck
body: My UAN shows the transfer request from my previous employer pending for 3 weeks. Whom should I follow up with?

replies.body: Checked on the EPFO portal — the claim is pending at your previous employer's approval step, not ours. Please raise a grievance from the UAN portal (I've attached the steps) and share the reference number; we'll follow up formally if it isn't cleared in 10 days.
